title: Milestone 1: CLI skeleton and config validation
description:
Build the first working slice of `afk`: a compilable binary with the v1 CLI shape, config parsing, and usage validation. This establishes the contract the rest of the loop runner will build on.

## Scope
- Repo bootstrap required for the Go binary
- CLI help behavior
- Argument splitting around the first `--`
- Parsing afk flags before the separator
- Validation of documented v1 flag combinations and usage errors
- Tests for the CLI usage contract in this slice

## Out of scope
- Loop execution
- Item parsing
- Process spawning
- Timeouts and signal handling beyond what is needed for usage/help behavior

## Specs
- `specs/prd-afk.html` §§4, 13, 15
- `specs/architecture.html` §§3, 5, 7
- `specs/coding-testing-standards.html` §§2, 5, 7, 9, 10

## Wires up
- The binary entrypoint, config parsing, and validation layer used by later milestones

## Acceptance
- `go build ./cmd/afk` succeeds
- `afk --help` prints usage to stdout and exits `0`
- Missing separator, missing main child command, unknown flags, and invalid flag combinations exit `2`
- Child command argv after the first `--` is preserved unchanged in parsed config
notes: Verified milestone acceptance after child tasks completion: go test ./... passes and go build ./cmd/afk succeeds; CLI contract coverage is in internal/afk tests and all milestone child tasks are closed.

title: Build a runnable afk binary with help output
description:
Create the initial Go module and binary structure needed for the documented build path, and implement the minimal entrypoint behavior required for `afk --help` to work correctly.

## Scope
- Add `go.mod`
- Add `cmd/afk/main.go`
- Add the initial internal package entrypoint
- Implement help output behavior at the binary boundary

## Out of scope
- Full CLI validation
- Loop execution
- Child process execution

## Specs
- `specs/prd-afk.html` §§4, 15
- `specs/architecture.html` §§3, 4, 5
- `specs/coding-testing-standards.html` §§1, 2.1, 6, 10

## Wires up
- Buildable module and binary entrypoint for subsequent CLI work

## Acceptance
- `go build ./cmd/afk` succeeds
- `afk --help` prints usage to stdout
- `afk --help` exits `0`
- `main` delegates to an internal entrypoint instead of containing loop logic
notes: Implemented initial Go module + entrypoints: cmd/afk/main.go now delegates to internal afk.Main. Added help path that prints usage to stdout and exits 0, with test coverage in internal/afk/main_test.go.

title: Parse afk CLI args and preserve the child command contract
description:
Implement the v1 CLI parsing rules so `afk` recognizes help early, splits at the first `--`, parses only afk flags before the separator, and preserves the main child command argv exactly as provided.

## Scope
- Recognize `-h` and `--help` before separator validation
- Split args at the first `--`
- Parse only pre-separator args as afk flags
- Preserve all post-separator args unchanged as the main child command
- Track explicit flag usage where validation depends on explicitness

## Out of scope
- Executing the child command
- Evaluating loop behavior

## Specs
- `specs/prd-afk.html` §§4, 13, 15
- `specs/architecture.html` §§5, 7, 8
- `specs/coding-testing-standards.html` §§2.2, 2.3, 7, 9

## Wires up
- Parsed config used by validation and later loop orchestration

## Acceptance
- Help is recognized without requiring `--`
- The first `--` separates afk flags from child argv; later `--` values remain in child argv
- The parser does not rewrite, reorder, or shell-wrap child argv
- Explicit user setting of `--sleep`, `--empty-sleeps`, and `--fail` is distinguishable from defaults
notes: Added internal/afk/config.go ParseArgs with first-separator splitting, pre-separator flag parsing, and raw post-separator CommandArgv preservation. Parse tracks explicit use of --sleep, --empty-sleeps, and --fail via flag.Visit. Added parser tests for separator behavior, help without separator, and explicit-flag tracking defaults vs explicit values.

title: Reject invalid v1 CLI usage with documented exit codes
description:
Implement config validation for the documented v1 rules and cover the milestone's usage contract so invalid usage fails fast with exit code `2`.

## Scope
- Validate required loop drivers
- Enforce mutual exclusivity and dependency rules among `--loops`, `--daemon`, `--items`, `--items-cmd`, `--fail`, `--until-success`, `--sleep`, `--empty-sleeps`, and `--timeout`
- Return usage exit `2` for invalid CLI usage
- Cover help, missing separator, missing child command, unknown flags, and invalid combinations

## Out of scope
- Child process execution
- Item-source runtime behavior

## Specs
- `specs/prd-afk.html` §§4, 13, 15
- `specs/architecture.html` §§5, 11, 13
- `specs/coding-testing-standards.html` §§5, 7, 9, 10

## Wires up
- Validated config for the loop, policy, and exec layers

## Acceptance
- Invalid combinations documented in the specs exit `2`
- Unknown flags exit `2`
- Missing separator and missing main child command exit `2`
- The milestone-1 CLI usage contract passes under `go test ./...`
notes: Implemented CLI usage validation for v1 config rules and wired Main to ParseArgs + ValidateConfig so usage failures return exit 2. Added comprehensive tests for explicit flag tracking, validation rules, and usage error exit behavior (missing separator, unknown flags, missing child command, invalid combinations).
